summary: Complete initial source-scope chronology audit of all 373 Chinese units, all 11 temporal or active-hint items, and all 3 people. This Tang ritual treatise contains legendary ritual context and the discrete 貞元三年八月 eclipse-rite exchange involving Emperor Dezong and Dong Jin. The current extraction is retained as evidence-grounded research holds pending independent source-critical confirmation of event ownership, regnal conversion, endpoint precision, and the distinction between a discrete ritual episode and personal chronology. No source, extraction, or canonical person data was changed.
